visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short dark hair and blunt bangs sits at a table in a bright indoor room. She leans her arms on the table and looks down at an object in her hands. (2) An adult's hand enters the frame holding a small instant photograph of two children. The girl examines the photo closely, touching her tongue to her lips. (3) The adult places the photo on the table. The girl leans over it, pointing with her finger at the faces in the picture. (4) The scene cuts to another photo on the table showing a man and a woman. The girl points at the man and smiles widely. (5) She looks up toward the person filming, rubbing her eye with one hand and gesturing toward the photos with the other. (6) A pink graphic background appears with a cartoon character of a girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
